questions.text_en: What is the current condition of your business premises?
questions.trigger: If Q037 = Yes and Q038 indicates a fixed premises (not a mobile unit); Q030 describes customer access, not the operating premises.
questions.reason: Identifies new construction versus existing premises; it is not a legal determination.
options: Existing building requiring renovation or fit-out
مبنى قائم يتطلب تجديدًا أو تجهيزًا داخليًا
Existing building requiring expansion or structural changes
مبنى قائم يتطلب توسعة أو تغييرات إنشائية

questions.text_en: What type of work are you planning for the existing building?
questions.text_ar: ما نوع الأعمال التي تخطط لتنفيذها في المبنى القائم؟
questions.trigger: If Q111 = existing building requiring renovation/fit-out OR expansion/structural changes
questions.reason: Distinguishes surface maintenance from renovation or structural work that may require a permit.

questions.text_en: Does the existing building have a building permit?
questions.text_ar: هل توجد رخصة بناء للمبنى القائم؟
questions.trigger: If Q112 = renovation of existing building elements OR structural changes/building expansion
questions.reason: Checks existing building documentation; an unknown answer does not mean the premises are unlicensed.

questions.text_en: What is the status of the required construction or renovation permit?
questions.text_ar: ما حالة رخصة البناء أو الترميم المطلوبة؟
questions.trigger: If permit applicability is determined and no fully verified owner-permit coverage exists
questions.reason: Tracks permit progress separately from service eligibility.

questions.text_en: Does the property owner already have a permit covering the planned renovation or modification work?
questions.text_ar: هل لدى مالك العقار رخصة تغطي أعمال التجديد أو التعديل المخطط لها؟
questions.trigger: If Q039 = Tenant/leased AND Q112 indicates potentially permit-requiring work
questions.reason: Checks for a potentially applicable owner-held permit without treating it as proof of eligibility or coverage.

questions.text_en: Are all your planned works covered by the property owner's existing permit?
questions.text_ar: هل تغطي رخصة مالك العقار القائمة جميع الأعمال المخطط لها؟
questions.reason: Distinguishes full coverage from partial or unknown coverage; user-reported and subject to verification.
options: Yes, all planned works are covered
نعم، تغطي جميع الأعمال المخطط لها

questions.text_en: Do you have authorization from the property owner to carry out the proposed construction or renovation work?
questions.text_ar: هل لديك موافقة من مالك العقار على تنفيذ أعمال البناء أو التجديد المقترحة؟
questions.trigger: If Q039 = Tenant/leased AND Q112 indicates work potentially requiring an additional permit
questions.reason: Tracks owner authorization separately from legal permit requirements.

questions.text_en: Has the existing permit been verified as valid and applicable to your planned work?
questions.text_ar: هل تم التحقق من صلاحية الرخصة القائمة وانطباقها على الأعمال المخطط لها؟
questions.trigger: If Q116 = all planned works covered OR partially covered
questions.reason: Records user-reported verification; it does not connect to or verify Balady records.
